title: Unit Event — On the Stage of Dazzling Light — Episode4 All to Achieve Stardom

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light
meta.Event Outline: Ever since his visit to Riley Dream Park, Tsukasa has felt a desire to improve even more as an actor. In the troupe's new ambassadorial show, he takes on a character unlike any he has before, with a personality entirely opposite his own.

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, that's it for our read-through.
How do you all feel about this...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, me first!
I really liked how Thorpe was able to play the piano like he wanted in the end!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's not what he's asking.
He's talking about how we each feel about the way we acted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
From what I saw...
It wasn't bad or anything, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After hearing what Rui said, I couldn't help but keep an eye on what Tsukasa did... He seemed different from usual...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree.
I believe we feel the same.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How did you feel, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: About that. I think I also felt what you just mentioned. Something just didn't feel quite right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How do I explain it...?
It's like I only have a superficial grasp of this character.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Superficial? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, that's the thing...
I'm not sure I understand how this character truly feels...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Thorpe, how's practice going?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, are you ad-libbing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “If you're trying to make a living by playing at a tavern, I have to think you're having a hard time paying rent. I wish I could help you somehow...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Th-Thank you...!
Your kinds words are more than enough!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, that isn't right either...
He's supposed to be lacking in confidence. He'd probably clam up in that sort of situation...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is what he meant by a “superficial grasp”. He's having trouble reading between the lines.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, now I get it!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's been able to capture a character's essence just based on instinct until now, but as I expected, this one may prove challenging.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mind telling us more about where you're getting stuck and how, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I appreciate the help!
First, the scene when he looks up to the stars is giving me some trouble...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Thorpe lacks confidence, but also seems fairly proud of himself. Even I'm having some trouble understanding him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nene, you might have a better idea.
How do you feel about this character?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that just a roundabout way of bad-mouthing people with pride but no confidence in themselves?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I never said anything about that combination being bad. It just means you're proud of yourself but prefer to take it slow when making important decisions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
You're always wonderhoy no matter what, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why does it feel like you're both trying to pull one over on me...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nene, I beg you!
Help me figure out how Thorpe feels!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My guess is that he's stressing over producing results, but also beating himself up for being so timid.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... But he has a goal he needs to work toward, right? He doesn't have any time to mope around like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, you're not wrong!
But it's not exactly easy to motivate yourself when you're in this kind of pain...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This is going to require more thought...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we keep working on our characters as we run through some lines?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “That piano sounds so wonderful♪”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Hey, Mr. Pianist!
Can you play a song for us?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Okay. Thorpe's a timid fellow, so let's try...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What the?!
Who goes there?!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Stop!
That's just you being you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Think more about how Thorpe would actually react.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Let's try that again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I tried being timid but went a little too far... No matter. I just have to try again...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Thank you, Mr. Pianist.
My little brother and sister seem much better now.”

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: “Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Ah, is that so...
You can leave now if you're satisfied.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry! Can we stop things here...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Something felt off about how I replied just now... “Ah, is that so...” No, maybe... “Ah, is that so...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I can't figure it out...
How would Thorpe respond in this situation...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...
One week later

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe we should stop here for today...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, sure...
Let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This is bad...
I've spent a week trying to figure out this role, but I'm still nowhere close...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (At this rate...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I should probably take a closer look at the original story. Otherwise, at this rate...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I hope Tsukasa's okay. He seemed really stuck today. Isn't there anything I can do to help him?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I already told him just about everything I can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Rui, what's wrong?
You seem really down.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, I was just thinking about Tsukasa's acting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I regret not putting more thought into this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More thought? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Until now, I kept assigning roles to Tsukasa that I thought would help bring out his potential...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His goal in life is “to become a world-famous star”. In retrospect, I regret not pushing his boundaries by assigning him more challenging roles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, I regret not thinking ahead more...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I don't believe it...
This is how he's taking this situation?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Usually, he doesn't really care as long as he got to do the shows he wanted.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But now... It's like he genuinely cares about all of our dreams and goals in life...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... You know there's no use crying over spilled milk, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Remember what you told me after what happened with me and my troupe? “You can look back all you want, but you can't change the past.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That cheered me up a lot.
It made me think, “That's all in the past, so I need to keep doing my best right now.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So I'm gonna tell you the same thing. The past is the past. All we can do right now is believe in Tsukasa and do what we can for him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should be coming up with hints or other ways to help him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, Nene.
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Ah, is that so...
You can leave now if you're satisfied.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “They're finally gone. I can practice in peace now... But there might not be any point now since the contest is tomorrow.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
I only have half a day left...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “The stars... They're so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, this still doesn't feel right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was under the impression that Thorpe looks up to the stars here to flee from his issues because he knows he can't overcome them before the contest...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But am I wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I don't know...
Not being able to figure this out means I'm far from the world-famous star I want to become...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No...
Now's not the time for that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, in times like this, there's but one thing for me to do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Yes...
Sitting on this bench really does put my mind at ease.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm home!
Tsukasa, you're back too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
The way Tsukasa plays the piano's always so beautiful.
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We don't have much time left until our show...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I need to rethink why Tsukasa's still having trouble with this role...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's clearly done a full analysis of his character. He understands what Thorpe's trying to achieve.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But he's still struggling to immerse himself into this role.. In a way, him and Thorpe are still “strangers”.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa's usually able to become one with a character and act as if he's in their shoes.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There has to be something that can help him become more comfortable with being Thorpe...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, I know...!
